name: 67010 · Augusta, KS
findings: ZIP 67010 (Augusta) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 67010 (Augusta) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
